verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on multiple items at once is that the Marketing Emails API can query post-send statistics for a set of emails. That is a multi-item read, not batch create, update or delete. Other cited endpoints work on one email at a time or simply list emails. missing for 10: documented batch create/update/delete endpoints, bulk edit or archive actions in the UI, batch size limits, agent- or MCP-driven bulk operations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
